QF.id: AIFM Modern Portfolio Theory and Capital Market Theory_15

question.text: Mahanadi Hybrid AIF holds Stock P (weight 25%, β = 1.0) and Stock Q (weight 75%, β = 1.4). The risk-free rate is 6% and the market risk premium is 10%. Using CAPM, what is the expected return of the portfolio?

explanation.text: The Logic: Portfolio β = 0.25·1.0 + 0.75·1.4 = 0.25 + 1.05 = 1.30. E(Rp) = Rf + β_p·MRP = 6% + 1.30·10% = 6% + 13% = 19%. The Trap: 18.00% uses the simple average β of 1.2 (0.5·1.0 + 0.5·1.4). 20.00% uses β = 1.4 directly (Q's beta). 17.80% uses inverted weights. Cross-Exam Context: Identical to XIX-C chapter-5 sample question; re-appears in XXI-B. Manager's Pro-Tip: When presenting a fund-of-AIFs beta to an LP, bottom-up beta-aggregation is more credible than top-down regression of the fund's smoothed NAV.
